description: painterly pixel art campsite map, Eastward style, 3/4 top-down view of a whole pine-highland forest campsite seen as one scene, warm sunlight from upper left. Top band: a dense layered wall of overlapping green pine canopies filling the top edge, dark trunks glimpsed between crowns, ferns and mossy boulders at its feet; above the wall a pale warm sky and two receding misty blue mountain ridges; a single gap in the wall slightly right of center holds a small wooden gate and hanging lantern, distant pines visible through it. A worn dirt trail enters from the bottom edge center, splits at a wooden signpost: the main branch runs up the middle to a dirt yard with a stone fire circle ringed by log benches and a cooking tripod, the west branch curls to a pond with a stone shore ring, short wooden dock, reeds and lily pads. Tent pitches: two loose arcs of small cleared grass patches each holding a colored dome tent, arranged around the fire yard. A teal camper van parked at the bottom-left trailhead beside stacked crates; upper-right work edge with a small wooden hut, chicken coop, clothesline and raised herb beds; one red-orange flamboyant accent tree beside the fire yard among green trees; a tiny spirit house shrine at the canopy feet east. Small props clustered on the trail and at the fire: lantern posts, firewood pile, water jugs, cooler, folding chairs. Asymmetric natural composition, soft painterly shading, full value range, muted warm palette, no text.
